No concurrent evidence changes alternative-preservation semantics. Preserve discordant GWT axis outcomes as alternatives rather than collapsing them to one concordance truth score.

Treat ignition steepness/beta as one dynamics feature only. Require intervention/lesion/rescue/null controls before any emergence inference; GWT concordance is not emergence or consciousness evidence.
